data: A rectangular grey marble plaque, of which the edges are all rough, although the text is complete.
sixlines of approximately equal height, centred on the stone; in lines 3 and 6 the final letter of the preceding line is carried over for the purposes of symmetry.
Elegantly carved rounded v-cut letters, with curving extensions to alpha; lunate epsilon and sigma, uncial omega; cursive mu.
First half of 3rd century CE (Manni Piraino)
According to Manni Piraino, an incomplete record in the museum only indicates that it was found in a private house in Marsala
I.Sicily with the permission of the Assessorato Regionale dei Beni Culturali e dell’Identità Siciliana - Dipartimento dei Beni Culturali e dell’Identità Siciliana; photo J. Prag 2024-12-03
Partially reopened following extensive restoration work. Comprehensive collection of archaeological material, predominantly from the West of the island, with an important Etruscan collection.

Text of IGPalermo checked against photograph

translation

Iason son of Artaphan lived blamelessly for 70 years; Theudora lived blamelessly for 60 years.

commentary

The stone is distinctive for the effort put into making the descriptions of age on lines 3 and 6 symmetrical, by using the final sigma of the preceding word on the line above to balance the numeral in each case. The name Jason is a common Hebrew one.
